page.overview:
Who is Baron Ironblood?

Baron Ironblood is the leader of the Red Shadows, sworn enemies of Action Force. According to Battle Action Force, his real name and birthplace are unknown (though a detailed comic book backstory, which featured in an early Battle Action Force annual, places him of possible Swiss descent).

In addition, Ironblood's datafile (as it appeared in Battle Action Force) states that his "primary military speciality" is organizational military strategy and that his "secondary military speciality" is that he is a born leader.thumb|Baron Ironblood's true face.

Twisted criminal brain dreams of world dominance. Noted for hypnotic control over men, his madness leads to wild fury in defeat, often taken out on his own troops.

Genius of Evil. Ironblood's sworn intent is to destroy all organised government in Europe.
